result.title: DeltaRAE: Derivative Tokenization for Long Video Generation
result.summary: Latent video generators are trained on clips of a few seconds, and much of this limit lies in their tokenizers, which spend as many tokens on a static frame as on a moving one and need future frames that do not exist during generation. We introduce DeltaRAE, a causal representation autoencoder for video. Its derivative tokenization encodes periodic anchor frames in full and all remaining frames with a few tokens each, and its causal encoder and decoder read a frozen pretrained image encoder. On UCF-101 and Kinetics-600, a standard diffusion transformer trained on DeltaRAE latents is competitive with state-of-the-art video tokenizers. DeltaRAE halves the tokenizer GFLOPs on 16-frame clips relative to keeping the same number of patch tokens for every frame, and it represents a minute of video with 18.8x fewer tokens. The tokenizer trains end to end on one-minute videos, and in video prediction a generator on its latents produces a full minute of video. The same generator collapses within 15 seconds in most videos when the tokenizer has the same token budget but no pretrained encoder.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DeltaRAE，一种面向长视频生成的因果表示自编码器：周期性完整编码锚帧、其余帧仅用少量 token 做「导数」式增量编码，并复用冻结的预训练图像编码器，使一分钟视频的 token 数大幅减少且可端到端训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作目标是视频 tokenizer 的压缩效率与长视频生成，未涉及视觉推理中的内部状态、证据获取、停止决策或答案归因；增量编码虽与状态更新形式相似，但仅为生成侧压缩技巧，缺少可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
